sources.title: Could Broncos rookie DT Tyler Onyedim replace John Franklin-Myers role on defense?
sources.description: After a small trade back that netted them an extra 6th-round pick, the Denver Broncos made their first selection of the 2026 NFL Draft, selecting Texas A&M defensive tackle Tyler Onyedim. He is a 6-3, 292-pound defensive lineman with 34-inch arms, and profiles as a one-gap penetrator for the Broncos. The Athletic’s Dane Brugler had […]
